dataset: PhysioNet EEGMMIDB v1.0.0, run R03 (motor execution, not motor imagery)
quality_ranking_metric: mean 3-fold balanced accuracy on source/training subjects only
independent_rerun_audit_status: AGGREGATE_EQUALITY_ONLY; per-run rerun JSON artifacts are absent, so independent execution is not fully auditable from the supplied package.

success_analysis.inferential_test: Not informative: all outcomes are failures; no success variance.

quality_utility_rank_correlation: Not performed inferentially because the quality predictor has only three model-level values repeated across subjects; row-level correlation would pseudoreplicate the predictor.

historical_analysis_superseded.row_level_spearman: Not used due model-level predictor pseudoreplication.

interpretation: Exploratory negative/inconclusive evidence under this specific offline motor-execution EEG-to-MyoSim configuration. The primary task-success endpoint was degenerate at 0/60. Secondary endpoints showed no detectable paired differences. This does not establish that decoder quality is generally unrelated to control utility.
critical_scope_limit: R03 contains motor-execution recordings, not motor-imagery trials. T1/T2 correspond to left/right fist movement on this run and were mapped to generic OPEN/CLOSE simulator intents as an abstract control mapping. This is not a semantically validated motor-imagery BCI mapping.
